blocks.text: Status: CANONICAL — CORE TRANSLATOR PIPELINE COMPLETE

The general-English interface analyzes ordinary surface phrases against all 436 indexed senses. It returns a deterministic ranked candidate list containing the sense ID, route, canonical target when one exists, invariant definition, selection cues, numerical score, confidence tier, match type, and explicit scoring evidence. Ties are ordered by sense ID, never source-file order.

Analysis is distinct from resolution. The translator may automatically resolve only one unique exact lemma with an explicit final runtime marker [0], [1], or [2], a direct atom or compound route, and no open compound slots. Every other case returns clarification requirements. Explicit resolution requires the selected sense, runtime state, speech act, and all required roles; it then passes through controlled English, canonical Semantic IR, EZF-1, and exact inverse decoding.

Exact-lemma matches begin at 1.0; contained lemmas at 0.72; partial lexical matches use bounded token coverage. Selection-cue overlap and definition overlap add bounded evidence, with the total capped at 1.0 and rounded to four decimals. Confidence is high at 0.90 or above, medium at 0.65 or above, and low below 0.65. Any competitor within 0.12 of the top score is materially ambiguous and prevents automatic resolution.

The translator never silently selects the first sense. A missing runtime state, close competing readings, a nonexact surface match, an open compound role, a Semantic-IR or grammar route, or a documented vocabulary gap causes a visible clarification. Direct atom and closed-compound candidates expose full Semantic-IR alternatives for the permitted runtime states. Slotted compounds expose required roles instead of incomplete IR.

Every indexed sense is available to ranking. Literal “go” exposes both spatial Motion and abstract-transition routes. “Change” exposes Data, Matter, Mind, Structure, and generic-transition readings. Context such as “represented information content” raises the Data reading but does not bypass the clarification rule for a nonexact surface phrase. “Food” and both readings of “home” remain explicit vocabulary gaps with no fabricated target.

The dedicated validator passes 16 of 16 checks. Exact-lemma recall is 436 of 436 indexed senses. Thirteen analysis fixtures cover unique, ambiguous, contextual, structural, grammar, gap, open-slot, unknown, and invalid-state inputs. Four resolution fixtures verify direct atoms, question contour, fully bound slotted compounds, and rejection of structural routes as single lexemes. Every successful resolution round-trips exactly. The complete project regression passes all prior semantic and translator layers.

This release changes no atomic or compound meaning, generated form, sense route, or etymology. The semantic core translator pipeline is now complete: general English analysis → explicit clarification or conservative resolution → controlled English → Semantic IR → deterministic renderer → inverse decoder. It is a safe indexed translator, not a claim of exhaustive English coverage. Glyph and audio output are the next authorized presentation gate and must not affect semantic identity.
